name: plugin.google_adk_optimizer
description: Google ADK GEPA (Generative Prompt Optimization) and multi-turn scenario evaluation engine.

entrypoints.name: adk_gepa_optimize_prompt
entrypoints.description: Run Generative Prompt Optimization (GEPA) to iteratively improve agent prompts against reference metrics

parameters.name: system_prompt
parameters.description: Base candidate system prompt to optimize

parameters.name: train_examples
parameters.description: Sample task queries with expected reference outputs or criteria

parameters.name: iterations
parameters.description: Number of generative mutation iterations to execute

entrypoints.name: adk_evaluate_agent
entrypoints.description: Evaluate agent execution against benchmark conversation scenarios

parameters.name: scenario_ids
parameters.description: List of scenario benchmarks to evaluate against

parameters.name: judge_model
parameters.description: Model used as the trajectory judge

entrypoints.name: adk_score_metrics
entrypoints.description: Score agent execution trajectories across multi-dimensional quality rubrics

parameters.name: trajectory
parameters.description: Chronological list of step events (role, content, tool_calls)
